execute_authorization.source: Owner requested Antigravity implementation after the harness commit is pushed to remote primary.

source_history.summary: XoaMu is the full layout and behavior blueprint for Anish /thi-thu; only Anish color/branding and shared shell differ.
Literal Chrome Ctrl+S Webpage Complete production-source references are required; screenshots alone are insufficient.
Build the supplied Vite 5173 and Express 7000 monorepo with /api proxy, MySQL, Redis, S3/Cloudinary and Gemini.
Implement the complete L&R and S&W surface without production exam data.
The catalog is public and authentication is required before attempt creation.
Deployment target is the existing VPS; Cloudflare is DNS/CDN/TLS rather than a Workers backend.
The old root prototype and its backup do not define the target architecture.
Production starts with an empty database; only synthetic development and test fixtures are allowed.
Antigravity starts after the harness commit exists on origin/master and implements on a feature branch.
Existing references contain screenshots and DOM/a11y captures but not a complete Webpage Complete corpus.
The reference has late anonymous grading 401s, missing media and public review-content exposure that must not be reproduced.
The old prototype install, lint and media baseline is not clean and cannot be the merge contract.

acceptance.claim: Literal Chrome Webpage Complete references cover the required route and state matrix and reopen offline.
The reference-to-component parity map covers desktop, mobile and all observed branches.
A clean checkout installs, builds, typechecks and lints both target applications.
Development topology is Vite 5173 through /api to Express 7000 with validated environment contracts.
MySQL migrations create the complete empty production schema safely.
Catalog, session and review API projections keep protected content separated.
Auth, ownership, revision and idempotency rules reject invalid and cross-user actions.

slices.name: Schema, auth and core exam API

acceptance.claim: Catalog and mode dialog match XoaMu geometry and behavior with Anish tokens.
Public browsing and login return preserve the selected exam and mode.
Catalog loading, empty, error, search, filter and no-result states are complete.
Attempt answers and media state autosave, resume, reconcile revisions and expire safely.
L&R Parts 1 through 7 support the complete exam and practice interactions.
L&R scoring, result, error map and authorized review are correct.
Microphone test, Speaking phases, timers and recording cover success and device failures.
Audio upload is bounded, retryable and never sends base64 or secrets through grading JSON or logs.
Writing editor sanitizes, counts, autosaves and restores content.
S&W grading jobs are durable, idempotent, schema-validated and retryable.
Processing, result, error map, review and history match the reference flow.
Secrets, logs, rate limits and ownership satisfy independent security review.
Production build, Nginx and PM2 configuration match the VPS and Cloudflare edge topology.
Synthetic fixtures pass complete L&R and S&W journeys from catalog through history.
Merge and operations documents allow a clean-checkout verifier to reproduce the setup and proof.

slices.name: Integration, VPS readiness and merge handoff

Verify source completeness, offline reopen, and route/state coverage.
Create clean two-app monorepo shells and contracts without importing the old prototype.
Review architecture, toolchain, ports, proxy, contracts, and clean-install evidence.
Implement secure schema, catalog and attempt APIs, auth ownership, revisions, and idempotency.
Review migration, public API, auth, ownership, answer isolation, and idempotency.
Implement the Xoa-parity catalog, mode dialog, states, and login-return behavior with Anish tokens.
Review desktop/mobile catalog parity and anonymous login-return behavior.
Implement resilient attempt lifecycle and full L&R runner, scoring, result, and review.
Review attempt persistence, L&R parity, scoring, result, and ownership.
Implement microphone, Speaking, Writing, sanitization, autosave, and secure media upload.
Review S&W parity, device failures, media lifecycle, sanitization, and redaction.
Implement durable grading, processing, result, error map, protected review, history, and security controls.
Review distributed grading, idempotency, security, result states, review, and history.
Integrate routes, run E2E, prepare VPS configuration, and produce merge/runbook handoff.
Verify clean checkout, synthetic journeys, VPS config, and merge documentation.
